questions.question: To whom did Jeremiah send a letter in chapter 29?
What did God tell the exiles to do in Babylon?
options: Rise up at once in open revolt against all of their captors
Refuse to do any work at all until they were finally set free
Build houses, plant gardens, and seek the welfare of the city
Wait there idly, for the long exile would very soon come to an end
questions.answer: Build houses, plant gardens, and seek the welfare of the city

questions.question: Jeremiah 29:11 says God has plans for welfare and not for evil, to give a future and a hope.
Seek the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the LORD on its _____.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a _____.
